glyph_bundles.name: Solar Invocation Bundle
glyph_bundles.description: Glyphs used together in solar hymns and invocations to Ra
glyph_bundles.typical_usage: Opening lines of solar hymns inscribed on tomb walls and papyri

glyph_bundles.name: Offering Formula Bundle
glyph_bundles.description: Core glyphs comprising the hetep-di-nesu offering formula
glyph_bundles.typical_usage: Funerary stelae and offering table inscriptions

glyph_bundles.name: Numeral Signs Bundle
glyph_bundles.description: Counting and tally glyphs including rope coil for hundreds
glyph_bundles.typical_usage: Accounting papyri, census records, measurement inscriptions

glyph_bundles.name: Human and Animal Determinatives
glyph_bundles.description: Determinative glyphs marking words related to people and animals
glyph_bundles.typical_usage: End of words denoting humans, cattle, or owls in running text

glyph_bundles.name: Basic Phonetic Signs Bundle
glyph_bundles.description: Common uniliteral phonetic signs used across all periods
glyph_bundles.typical_usage: Spelling of words, royal names, and epithets in all inscription types
